module: Applies the vehicle paints: vehicleConfig.paints (or, failing that, vehicleConfig.colors converted by convertVehicleColorsToPaints) provides up to three paints. For each one, validateVehiclePaint checks it, then baseColor becomes the object's color (paints[1] -> color, paints[2] -> colorPalette0, paints[3] -> colorPalette1). The whole list is then sent to the engine via setMetallicPaintData for the metallic/clearcoat parameters.
notes: baseColor is an array {r, g, b, a}.
convertVehicleColorsToPaints and validateVehiclePaint are global functions defined elsewhere.

process.desc: Applies the config's paints to the vehicle object and passes on the metallic paint data.
